data.title: Packet return contract
data.quote:
## Return contract

Write the full result to the result file, then reply in ≤ 150 words: status, result file path, its
sha256 (`sdlc digest --path <file>`), one line per blocking item.

- Worker result: status · claims (OBSERVED/DERIVED/ASSUMED) · evidence pointers · artifact paths ·
  checks run with results · open doubts (HIGH/LOW) · weakest link.
- Reviewer result: verdict PASS/FAIL · failure class · blocking findings with evidence · rules or
  units not covered · weakest link.

data.title: Controller loop: dispatch and record
data.quote:
3. **Dispatch.** Per unit, write a facts JSON (`weakestClaim`, `observed`, `doubts`, `settled`,
   `authorizedPaths`, and `findingsToFix` on a round two), then `$SDLC packet --ticket <id> --node <n> --unit <u> --facts <file>`.
   Dispatch each unit as its `agentType` (`sdlc-worker` / `sdlc-deep`) to a distinct fresh subagent with one line:
   *"Read the packet at `<path>` (sha256 `<packetDigest>`) and execute it."* Units with disjoint outputs go in one
   message. The controller never fills a missing unit.
4. **Verify, then record.** Check the result file exists and its digest; spot-check the citations the
   gate depends on (open the cited `path:line` yourself). Then
   `$SDLC record --ticket <id> --node <n> --unit <u> --result <file> --model <model> --tokens <n> [--verdict ...]`.
   A model other than the planned one is refused. Then the reviewer unit, if planned, over the latest results.
   Reviewer FAIL `record`-class → fix the record and re-record; `artifact`-class → re-dispatch the failed
   worker (resume the same agent when the host allows) then one more reviewer round.

data.title: Test: invalidating coding keeps the test cases
data.quote:
def test_invalidate_coding_keeps_testcases(self) -> None:
        profile = load_profile(self.profile)
        graph = G.load_graph(HOME, profile, self.tmp)
        order = G.trace(graph, build_context(profile, "T", "bug", None, None, None))
        stale = G.dependents(graph, order, "coding")
        self.assertIn("code-review", stale)
        self.assertIn("final-review", stale)
        self.assertNotIn("testcase", stale)  # test cases derive from the plan, not the code
        self.assertNotIn("testcase-review", stale)
data.note: All 8 tests passed on 2026-11-04 (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
